explication: MJML is a markup language and compiler for responsive email HTML. The main workflow accepts MJML, parses it into a tree, validates and renders components, then returns or writes HTML; the CLI adds file, stream, watch, and output modes. The graph also preserves the standard component library and configuration/preset capabilities. Some subsystem links are documented or indexed imports; unsampled component and validator internals are represented at their existing package directories, without asserting unshown call paths.
